recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12305 unless a future rendered-build review identifies a new CodeSystem page regression unrelated to the historical DSTU2 text.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocabulary issue for the CodeSystem resource, raised and applied for DSTU2, asking to fix an invisible "Code systems with detailed metadata" header and replace mistaken ValueSet resource references with CodeSystem terminology in the detailed-metadata narrative.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 11138. The git-svn mirror has commit 18216260c48e04bb4d48132fdfb6b4be72e418f7, "#12305 - fix typos", which edited source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml to remove misleading standalone ValueSet wording from the old section.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists CodeSystem as an active current resource and conformance artifact, so source/codesystem is in build scope. Later CodeSystem notes refactors removed the old detailed-metadata section from the current source, and targeted source searches found no remaining old heading, old section anchor text, or mistaken ValueSet-resource wording. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the requested typo correction is already reflected in the current active source and no new source edit is needed.
